hook.h2: He compares Himself to a nursing mother, and then says He is more faithful still
hook.text: "Can a woman forget her nursing child, that her heart would not be moved with compassion for the son of her womb? Even these may forget, yet I will not forget you.
father: "Can a woman forget her nursing child, that her heart would not be moved with compassion for the son of her womb? Even these may forget, yet I will not forget you.
hook.note: When our Father wanted a picture of love that does not let go, He reached for a mother with a baby at her breast — and then said He outlasts even that. A mom knows exactly how strong the comparison is, which is why the second half lands so hard. You are the one who remembers everybody. He is the One who remembers you.

short350: You have wanted a Father your whole life. Not a doctrine about Him. Not a distant power. A Father — His voice, His heart turned toward you.
Father's Heart Bible is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking. Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's in RED. The Spirit's in PURPLE.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, words He never spoke are never colored, and narration stays black.
Hannah prayed with her lips moving and no sound coming out, and the priest assumed she was drunk. Our Father heard every word of it, and answered her. He hears what no one else can hear.
That is what this Bible was made to do. Not to tell you about a Father who speaks, but to show you where He already has.

A mom spends her days being the one everybody comes to — the one who hears the crying at 2 a.m., who notices the mood before it is spoken, who carries the mental list nobody else can see. This edition exists to put something in her hands that runs the other direction. Not one more thing to keep up with. A Father whose voice is marked on the page so she can find it in the four minutes she actually gets.

He is not distant. He is not disappointed. He is your Heavenly Father, and He delights in you as His beloved daughter. If father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you: the Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood, but the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

An introduction opens each book, a Father's note closes each with a short prayer, and 1,354 notes serve the reader, not the scholar. A presentation page carries her name. Six by nine, hardcover, full color throughout.
A fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek — complete, 66 books and 31,085 verses. A gift, a keepsake, an heirloom.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

long.h: Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.
body: The Mom's Bible is a color coded Bible for moms, mothers, new moms and stepmoms — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking.
Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's words in RED. The Spirit's words in PURPLE.

It is the complete Father's Heart Bible™ — 66 books, 876 pages, the same translation carried in every edition — bound and opened for a mother. What is hers is the cover, and the pages that come before Genesis 1:1.

long.h: You are the one everyone comes to. Your Father is the One you can come to.
body: Hannah prayed at Shiloh with her lips moving and no sound coming out. Eli thought she was drunk. Our Father heard every word, and she went home with her face no longer downcast. “I prayed for this child, and our Father has granted me what I asked of him.” — 1 Samuel 1:27. “My heart exults in my Father” — 1 Samuel 2:1.
Your Father heard what no one else could hear. He hears you the same way. It is a devotional Bible for daily Bible reading and intimacy with God, so you hear Him for yourself.

That is the whole reason a mom's edition exists. Not because a mother needs a simpler Bible — she does not — but because being the one everybody comes to makes it easy to forget you were somebody's beloved daughter first. The opening pages say that before the reading plan ever starts.

long.h: A three color Bible: red letter, blue letter, purple letter
body: For a hundred and twenty-five years, the red letter Bible has shown you the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. He has been speaking the whole time. No Bible has ever shown you where.
Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's words in RED. The Spirit's words in PURPLE. More than one word in four of this Bible is a divine person speaking.

The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation. His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored. Narration stays black. You can see it for yourself before you buy anything: every word is free to read at fathersheartbible.com/read.

God is our Father. Not a role He plays. Father is who He is, and Father is His name, the name Jesus came to reveal: “I revealed your name to those you gave me from the world” (John 17:6). This translation lets the Hebrew and Greek speak the distinction they always made: God as Father, Abba Father, your Heavenly Father — and you, His beloved child.

Notice who, in Scripture, speaks of Him only as a distant deity and never as Father: the serpent in Eden, Pharaoh, the accusers in Job, the tempter in the wilderness. The enemy's strategy has not changed since the garden — to make the Father seem distant, demanding, and disappointed.

If the word father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you. The Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood. He is the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

faq.q: What makes the Mom's Bible different from the other editions?
faq.a: It is the complete Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color — the same translation, the same 876 pages, the same 1,354 study notes as every other edition. What is made for a mom is the cover and the pages that open the book: a word written for this reader, and passages on intimacy, identity, and inheritance chosen for where they are. We would rather tell you that plainly than claim notes or prayers that are not in it.

faq.q: Is this the whole Bible, or a selection?
faq.a: The whole Bible. 66 books, 1,189 chapters, 31,085 verses, Genesis to Revelation, nothing abridged — 876 pages of it, in full color throughout.

For a hundred and twenty-five years red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and until now those words were printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color marks ownership, not quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

faq.q: Can I read it before I buy a copy?
faq.a: Yes, all of it. Every word of the Father's Heart Bible™ is free to read at fathersheartbible.com/read, in twenty-five languages, with the color on the page exactly as it is in print. English and Telugu can also be listened to. Nobody has to buy anything to receive our Father's voice.

faq.q: Is this a good Mother's Day or new-mom gift?
faq.a: It is made for it. A complete hardcover Bible with a dust jacket and a presentation page for her name and the date — the kind of thing that gets handed on rather than replaced. For a new mom, the opening pages are the part to point her to: they are four pages long, which is about the attention a newborn leaves you.

faq.q: My mom already has three Bibles. Why this one?
faq.a: Because she has never seen this. Every Bible she owns prints our Father's 125,457 words in the same black ink as the genealogies. This one shows her where He is speaking, on every page, from Genesis to Revelation. It is also a fresh translation from the original languages rather than another edition of one she already has.
